title: Home, universal skeleton (consensus of the sample)
when: No niche recipe fits, or the store mixes several niches. Start here and swap presets.
evidence: the common structure of 43 home pages

steps.when: one commercial promise on a dark bar: the usual choice
steps.note: One real commercial promise, or leave the bar out.

variants.when: a soft brand tint (kids, beauty, playful and premium looks)
2-3 short service promises the merchant confirmed

steps.when: a flat menu of up to 6-8 short items: the categories show on desktop
steps.note: Brand-led store with a flat menu of up to 6-8 items; a nested menu takes `centered-logo-burger`.

variants.when: a nested or long menu that would not fit as links
a short flat menu and a left-aligned look (journal, dense catalog)
a large assortment: catalog button, mega menu, wide search

steps.when: photography with a quiet zone for the live text

variants.when: a catalogue look: the hero inside the grid with the theme's rounding
one strong text-free image, full height on phones (journal, premium, dark drop)
a designed first screen: headline, button and photo composed in the markup (kit-custom-sections)

steps.note: Real categories, every tile linked. Its title is a phrase about what the store sells: the storefront makes it the page's H1 (a banner title never is).

variants.when: more than 4 categories
two departments or audiences (women and men, adults and kids)

steps.note: Shelf A: new arrivals or bestsellers.

variants.when: one curated row of 4

steps.when: journal and premium: one brand phrase set large across the page (kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: The signature block: one block that only this store has, chosen by the look (references/looks.md).

variants.when: gallery and dense catalog: a mosaic of products or collections in tiles of different sizes (kit-custom-sections)
dark drop and playful: a running line of short brand words (kit-custom-sections)
native fallback: two large images with an overlay title

steps.when: bigger cards for the second source, a change of rhythm
steps.note: Shelf B: another source and another column count.

variants.when: every packshot on one backdrop: an edge-to-edge product wall (gallery look)
one curated row of 4

steps.when: the default story: eyebrow, a heading phrase, 16 px text at 560-640 px, a button to a real page, a 1:1 or 3:4 photo (`mediaRatio`; kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: One story block in the middle third that leads somewhere: a button or a last-line link to the catalog, a collection or the About page.

variants.when: native fallback the merchant edits in the cabinet: a narrowed section, `###` heading, one paragraph of 300 characters or less ending with a link
no photo for the story: one centred statement of 100-200 characters ending with a link

steps.note: Shelf C (sale, a category). Drop it when the store has fewer than three distinct sources.

variants.when: new arrivals or bestsellers, 12 cards

steps.when: customer photos, stores or press the merchant has
steps.note: Customer photos, stores or press, only if real.

variants.when: one strong real review with a name and a photo (kit-custom-sections)
3-6 real reviews (kit-custom-sections)
a centred theme and a brand-led page: a narrow column with air
a rounded theme (playful, soft): the questions on one card

steps.when: text left, form right: the usual closing band
steps.note: Last content section; `flow-into-footer` to merge with the footer.

variants.when: a centred form on a neutral band (centred themes)
on the footer palette, so the subscription and the footer read as one closing block

steps.note: Optional strip on the footer palette.

variants.when: off-white, grey or cream: soft and premium looks

notes: Layout theme preset by assortment: `layout-editorial` for image-led brands, `layout-boxed-catalog` for wide catalogues.
